### "Good Fish, Bad Fish" - Crosswalk the Devotional - July 19, 2012
Author: Ryan Duncan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/good-fish-bad-fish-crosswalk-the-devotional-july-25-2012.html
Passage: Matthew 13:47-50
Points:
- A deep-sea fishing trip that caught both an edible red snapper and an unwanted, aggressive eel illustrates the sorting process in the Parable of the Net.
- Just as fishermen separate good fish from useless catches, the kingdom of heaven involves a final sorting of the righteous from those who reject God.
- Unlike human fishermen, God continually casts out His net because He actively seeks a relationship with every person.
- Believers are invited to yield to Christ, the unique fisherman whose capture leads to true freedom.
